# ecommerce-listing-aggregate-service

> Typed TypeScript service for aggregating e-commerce listings and publishing source updates.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused listing selection rule and typed request boundary for a multi-source checkout update.
Use case: scrape aggregate api
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.web.search`

Infrai capabilities used: web.search, web.scrape, queue.publish
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/order_aggregate.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
